sources.title: Environmental Impact Assessment: Mumbai Metro Lines 2A and 7

verifiedSections.claim: The Line 2A Dahisar East platform is located above the already proposed Dahisar East station for the Andheri East–Dahisar corridor (Line 7).

sources.evidenceLimits: Relative project-design order only; not a current as-built floor survey, platform-number assignment, or transfer-route description.

sources.title: MMRDA Line 2A Current Station List and Commissioning Phases
sources.evidence: Publishes the current 17-station Line 2A sequence from Dahisar East through Andheri West and the operational phase groupings.
sources.evidenceLimits: Current stop names and service sequence; does not publish station-specific platform numbering or transfer path dimensions.

sources.title: MMRDA Line 7 Current Station List and Commissioning Phases
sources.evidence: Publishes the Line 7 operational sequence and Line 1/2A/6 interchange locations. MMRDA lists 13 named stops from Gundavali through Ovaripada; Dahisar East is maintained as the shared corridor terminal entity in the current CTM.
sources.evidenceLimits: Current route/station list; no station-by-station platform-number mapping or transfer measurements.

sources.title: MMRDA Andheri West station three-level announcement
sources.evidence: As-built Line 2A Andheri West has Property Development, Concourse and Platform levels; the MMRDA release says it is connected with D.N. Nagar (Line 1) at two levels for passenger movement.
sources.evidenceLimits: Does not provide passenger-path length, walk duration, AFC retap or security rule.

sources.title: MMRDA Gundavali–WEH Foot Overbridge announcement
sources.evidence: MMRDA reports a 58 m structural FOB span connecting Gundavali (Line 7) and Western Express Highway (Line 1).
sources.evidenceLimits: The 58 m is only the bridge structure span, not the full platform-to-platform passenger route or transfer time.

sources.title: MMMOCL Fare Schemes and Products
sources.publisher: Maha Mumbai Metro Operation Corporation Limited
sources.evidence: MMMOCL describes ticket validity for Lines 2A and 7. Used as a scope boundary for those fares; this page does not document the detailed AFC transfer policy with Line 1.
sources.evidenceLimits: Does not establish a specific interchange retap rule.

sources.title: NDTV Profit report on Line 2A/7 separation and Dahisar interchange
sources.evidence: Reports that passengers can transfer between Lines 2A and 7 at Dahisar without exiting the paid area, citing the 8 April 2026 operating change.
sources.evidenceLimits: Secondary report; does not give measured walking distance/duration or explicitly describe the AFC device transaction. Treat no-exit as operator-reported and do not infer a meter/minute value.

sources.title: Andheri (W) station consist of 3 levels
sources.evidence: MMRDA identifies Property Development, Concourse, and Platform levels at Andheri West station.

currentPlatformNumbering.note: DPR does not number operational platforms. Public route planners disagree on platform numbers/directions at Line 7 stations, so those values are not promoted into the database.

line2a.reportedPattern: Several route planners list Platform 1 toward Dahisar East and Platform 2 toward Andheri West at ordinary stops.
line2a.conflict: Terminal-specific pages disagree or describe an alighting/pocket platform, and no current operator station plan found in public sources maps every physical platform number.

line7.conflict: The cited route planners reverse Platform 1/2 directions at Magathane. Since Red Line through service now continues over Line 9, an older P1-toward-Gundavali assumption is also not safe as a current system-wide mapping.

platformNumbering.handling: Do not write platformNumber/towardsStationId pairs to PostgreSQL until station signage or an operator as-built platform map resolves station-specific labels.

andheriWestDnNagar.handling: Indicative third-party estimates only; they do not define a measured in-station passenger path, so canonical distance/time remain null.

secondaryReports: A published commuter account says about 50 m; another personal report says about 150 m.
gundavaliWeh.handling: Different starting/ending points and user reports conflict; the 58 m bridge span is verified, full route metres/minutes remain null.

dahisarEast.handling: Paid-area transfer is reported, but no public source found with a measured platform-to-platform distance/time.

dprInternalConflicts.issue: Station 12 Kasturi Park chainage/distance differs between Table 5.2.1 and §5.3.2.12; station 13 distance also differs between the two sections.
dprInternalConflicts.handling: Both claims are preserved in B-station-infrastructure-l2a-line7-dpr-evidence.json; do not resolve by assumption or use these values to validate alignment until the primary design discrepancy is resolved.

dprInternalConflicts.issue: Dahisar terminal level count wording conflicts: §5.2.2.2 says stations are two-level except Dahisar Terminal; §5.3.3.1 says all stations are two-level.
dprInternalConflicts.handling: MMRDA's EIA independently establishes the relative design order (Line 2A platform above the Line 7 Dahisar station), but does not resolve the number/names of all Dahisar levels or current as-built details. Keep detailed level inventory unresolved; DPR confirms two corridor platforms.

crosswalkCaveats.line2a: All 17 design keys are spatially crosswalked to current operational IDs using official station list, DPR station chainage/locality descriptions, and official GIS locations. Old labels remain design-era names, not current aliases.
crosswalkCaveats.line7: 14 DPR keys spatially crosswalk to current operational CTM IDs. Hub Mall and Vishveshwar Nagar remain unbound DPR-only proposals; available operator list and GIS show no separate operational stations, but do not establish whether the project formally deleted, consolidated, or relocated them.

unverifiedAttributes.platformNumbering: The DPR does not verify current numeric platform labels at each station.
unverifiedAttributes.platformDirection: The DPR does not map numeric platform labels to current terminal directions.
unverifiedAttributes.platformArrangement: Two physical platforms are proposed, but these sources do not substantiate current station-specific island/side arrangement.
unverifiedAttributes.wheelchairBoarding: DPR design intent is not proof of current station-specific boarding/accessibility status.
unverifiedAttributes.equipmentAsBuilt: Projected lift/escalator counts are design forecasts; installed/current operation not verified.
unverifiedAttributes.interchangeWalkDistance: No measured current transfer distance established.
